title: Screensaver shows bottom bar in Android 9.0
symptom: The screensaver in xDrip+ shows the very bright bottom navigation bar, which also slows down charging. The issue persists across several versions and on a Samsung S9+ with Android 10.
cause: The cause is not definitively established. The maintainer suspects it is a phone behavior rather than an xDrip issue, possibly related to Android navigation bar settings or day/night mode.
fix: No fix is provided. The maintainer suggests adjusting phone behavior, and the reporter notes that using day mode instead of night mode might affect the brightness, but no concrete resolution is given.
evidence_quote: I don't think the Android control panel characteristics are a part of xDrip. I suspect this should be addressed by adjusting the behavior of the phone rather than the behavior of xDrip.
